breakdown.description: The prompt forms the torsional strain energy with the bending second moment I instead of the polar moment J, which is inconsistent with torsion theory.
breakdown.reason: The generated specification correctly uses J = π d^4/32 (the polar moment) in the torsional strain energy expression U = ∫[0→L] T^2/(2GJ) dx, and makes no mention of using the bending second moment I = π d^4/64. This matches the ground truth prompt, which removes the incorrect instruction to substitute I in place of J.
